summary: AI Grant's official site still describes funding for AI-native product startups, but current application deadlines or cohort dates are not publicly posted.

proposed_event.name: AI Grant
proposed_event.description: Funding program for AI-native product startups, offering uncapped SAFE investment and founder support.

dates.date_range_text: Applications appear to be accepted through the official website, but no current deadlines, cohort dates, or cadence are published.

sources.title: AI Grant
sources.supports: Official site identifies AI Grant as a program for AI-native product startups and states founders can apply; it describes AI Grant as a fund rather than publishing a dated cohort.

sources.title: AI Grant - Funding
sources.supports: Official homepage states selected companies receive $250k on an uncapped SAFE and support including advice and help from AI operators and investors; no application deadline or cohort dates are shown.

notes: Official pages available at https://aigrant.com/ show program terms and application entry point, but not a 2026 application window, batch schedule, demo day, or location.
Source context notes possible uncertainty after Nat Friedman joined Meta; no official discontinuation notice was found on the homepage, so this is marked needs_review rather than inactive.
